scope: Quantity-clean v5 candidate actual purchase forms plus sesame saute correction; research only. References filename:N are one-based observations[N-1]. No prices, stock claims, retailer production integration or nutrient import.

region_evidence.wording: Official neutral Lenta category lists Saint Petersburg delivery; product evidence is separate.

exclusions: Fried/salad/composite vegetables, dried/candied/canned pineapple are not raw fruit proof.
Fresh green beans were not inferred from frozen products or consumer review wording.
KOTANYI and PREMIUM CLUB sesame oils explicitly unsuitable for frying/heating are not recipe saute evidence.
Expired GEA flyers, Krasnodar/Voronezh-bound Okey sesame product results, and user-authored recipes are not qualifying five-chain availability.
BIOLIO manufacturer's indexed primary catalogue has a low-heat garlic-frying recipe, but its live PDF failed retrieval; it is not the selected oil proof.
Yarche matching product specification is not counted as a sixth retailer or as Saint Petersburg availability.
